description: Draft a full multi-stage labeling workflow from a plain-language brief (NL pipeline authoring). The draft is validated against the same graph validator the canvas publishes through and persists as a DRAFT workflow version — a human reviews and publishes; nothing goes live from this call. Requires open-label:write scope and the workflow_agents feature.

brief.description: The pipeline goal, e.g. "pre-label tickets with AI, route low-confidence ones to humans, jury-check approvals".

name: open_label_pipeline_draft
